name: Nezu Tetsuya
source:
[url=/c11601]Tooru[/url] is a triple threat with his menacing expression, poor sociability, and tendency to collapse suddenly, but Tetsuya is a friend who tells him not to worry about it, like it’s no big deal. 

He’s a thoughtless idiot and often talks about other girls in front of his girlfriend [url=/c17215]Asahi[/url], who get easily jealous, but he’s also a good, innocent person. 

But it’s a pain when he and Asahi are together. In a sappy couple sort of way.

[Based on [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180616215827/https://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1064]Mangagamer[/url]]
